source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: At f89c674387dd34beb8894e51720f71399f4b7e20, GenericSendMessage keeps the returned dependent spellcheck window, awaits load only when document.readyState is not complete, then awaits unload before reading cancelSendMessage. The fixed accepted caller also awaits load when location.href is about:blank. That later condition checks document identity separately from readyState and must not be attributed to the assigned landing. The existing dependent-dialog completion lesson covers the broader send/cancel ordering; this finding adds only the exact guard difference. No dependent-window navigation, early close or actual send was executed.
title: The send spellcheck wait checks document state and document URL separately
